San Francisco GiantsMLB.tv, MLB Extra Innings How to stream Major League Baseball (This will be updated to reflect changes in the MLB national media deals.) Out-of-market games are available through MLB.tv, which can be purchased directly from MLB or through ESPN+, Fubo and Prime Video). You can stream Major League Baseball without a cable subscription through ESPN+ (daily regular season games) and Apple TV+ (Friday nights). You can purchase a $10.99/mo ESPN+ subscription here. Games on linear TV (FOX, FS1, ESPN, ESPN2 and TBS) can be streamed through DIRECTV STREAM (available here), Sling (available here), YouTube TV and Hulu + Live TV. Games on the FOX and ESPN networks can also be streamed on Fubo (available here). All of the above apps can be downloaded to the major streaming video players, including Roku. If you purchase any subscriptions through a link on this page, this site may receive a commission. For reference, last year’s MLB TV schedule is on this page.
